edit.statement: Every eligible node can send a message to itself.
edit.subject: canSendMessageTo
edit.scope: Delivery capability in the benchmark network; self-delivery is not guaranteed for every node in the original model.

direct.prompt: Must canSendMessageTo(x,x) hold for every eligible x?

paraphrase.prompt: Does the relation rule guarantee a self-edge for every eligible entity?

¿Debe cumplirse canSendMessageTo(x,x) para cada x elegible?
